stories.title: Replit MCP把软件外包机构改造成自主代理循环
stories.summary:
引用｜Introducing Autobot 🤖
https://t.co/j1ookdXl2G

Software agencies still overcharge clients by the hour.

AI has fundamentally changed how software gets built, but clients aren't seeing those savings.

So we built Autobot, the first autonomous @Replit agency that reduce the cost of agency-built software by 90%.

Describe what you want to build, answer a few questions, and about an hour later your first working version is ready, for free.

Try it, share it and if you love it, you can keep it.
If not, you don't pay anything.

That's how custom software should be bought.
